name: Celebrity Ghost Stories
description: Compelling, surprising and downright spooky — celebrities share their real-life personal encounters with the paranormal in each one-hour special. From encounters with ghosts and angry spirits to haunted homes, unexplainable spells and magic, these descriptive, first person narratives from our favorite stars delivers a brand new way of experiencing the thrills and chills of the addictive world of the paranormal.

videos.title: 25 Scariest Moments Special (#1)
videos.overview: For the past several years, celebrities have been sharing their terrifying personal paranormal experiences with their fans. From Marilyn Manson, Billy Dee Williams, and Michael Imperioli to Audrina Patridge, Elisabeth Rohm, and Kevin Pollack, "Celebrity Ghost Stories 25 Scariest Moments" counts down the most frightening and hair raising stories of all time.

videos.title: Ten Scariest Ghost Children
Joan Rivers, Scott Baio, Teri Polo, David Carradine
videos.overview: Joan Rivers talks about an encounter with an angry ghost; Scott Baio recounts a story involving unresolved issues with his deceased father; Teri Polo remembers a childhood experience; and David Carradine has an encounter with his wife's dead husband.

videos.title: Barry Williams, Debi Mazar, Sammy Hagar, Greg Grunberg
videos.overview: Barry Williams has an unusual experience during a memorial service for his father; Debi Mazar has an encounter with a ghost when she moves into a friend's home; Sammy Hagar is visited by Van Halen's deceased manager; and Greg Grunberg encounters a ghost.

videos.title: Carrie Fisher, John Waters, Federico Castelluccio, Rue McClanahan
videos.overview: Carrie Fisher recalls an experience that happened after her friend died in her bed; John Waters recounts a scary memory from the 1950s; Federico Castelluccio believes a presence was in his workshop with him watching him paint; and Rue McClanahan recalls a friend's deathbed experience.

videos.title: Tom Arnold, Dee Snider, Carnie Wilson, Nia Long
videos.overview: Tom Arnold recalls an incident from his teens involving a pipe organ; Dee Snider remembers receiving a message from his murdered brother-in-law; Carnie Wilson relates how her sister introduced her to the spirit world; and Nia Long remembers an experience surrounding the death of her grandfather.

videos.title: Lisa Rinna, Vincent Curatola, Jeffrey Ross, Illeana Douglas
videos.overview: Lisa Rinna recalls a ghost haunting; Vincent Curatola remembers an experience involving his mother; Jeffrey Ross recounts a haunting; and Illeana Douglas recalls an experience involving a new apartment.

videos.title: Carnie Wilson, Eric Roberts, Elisabeth Rohm, C. Thomas Howell
videos.overview: Carnie Wilson meets the ghost of a 19th-century barber; Eric Roberts has an out-of-body experience following a car wreck; Elisabeth Rohm sees an apparition; and C. Thomas Howell has an encounter in an abandoned hotel.

videos.title: Justine Bateman, Jay Thomas, Traci Lords, James Kyson Lee
videos.overview: A spirit makes Justine Bateman's life a lot merrier; Jay Thomas mistakenly uses stones taken from a tombstone for a home renovation and pays a price; Traci Lords has a life-saving run-in with a miner's ghost; and James Kyson Lee opens the door to a hellish nightmare when he reads an underground ghost magazine.

videos.title: Anson Williams, Ali Landry, Gina Gershon, Kelly Carlson, Ernie Hudson
videos.overview: Anson Williams gets help from the world beyond after a terrible car accident; Ali Landry gets an unbelievable phone call on the eve of a family tragedy; Gina Gershon experiences a strange presence in a college dorm; Kelly Carlson is bullied by six violent spirits; and Ernie Hudson agrees to stay at a haunted hotel while promoting his movie, Ghostbusters.

videos.title: Morgan Fairchild, John Salley, Lili Taylor, Vincent Curatola
videos.overview: A young Morgan Fairchild is abused by a spirit when she moves into her new husband's family home; an unidentifiable stranger comes to John Salley's aid during a nightclub shooting; Lili Taylor hears unexplained noises when she goes on retreat with her acting troupe; and Vincent Curatola communicates with his dead father.

videos.title: Michael Imperioli, Joan Collins, Donna D'Errico, Corey Feldman
videos.overview: Michael Imperioli meets a tormented spirit at a legendary New York hotel; Joan Collins enrages a vengeful ghost during a dinner party in Venice; a young Donna D'Errico befriends a little girl who's not what she seems; and a spirit gets Corey Feldman's life back on track.

videos.title: Tracey Gold, Alice Cooper, Fred Dryer, Kathryn Erbe
videos.overview: The spirit of a lonely child seeks refuge with Tracey Gold; a mischievous spirit plays pranks on Alice Cooper; Fred Dryer sees more than the campus while visiting a school with his daughter; and the evil spirit of a camper taunts teenage Katherine Erbe.

videos.title: Billy Baldwin, Tempestt Bledsoe, Tracy Nelson, Eric Balfour
videos.overview: A stay at a desolate hotel confirms Billy Baldwin's belief in the other side; a terrifying encounter forces Tempestt Bledsoe out of a hotel room in the nick of time; the ghost of Errol Flynn haunts the house of Tracy Nelson; and Eric Balfour gets more than he bargained for when ghost hunting in an infamous, abandoned hotel.

videos.title: Paulina Porizkova, Chazz Palminteri, Michael Urie, Karina Smirnoff
videos.overview: Paulina Porizkova is terrified to meet the former owner of her country home; a spirit wants Chazz Palminteri to deliver an important message; Michael Urie summons a desperate spirit while playing with a Ouija board; a loved one returns from the dead hoping to give Karina Smirnoff a last goodbye.

videos.title: Shirley Jones, Lindsay Wagner, Mykelti Williamson, Matthew Settle
videos.overview: Shirley Jones has a life-threatening run-in with a ghost who plays with fire; Lindsay Wagner has a paranormal experience with a tortured teenage spirit; Mykelti Williamson gets a terrifying phone call from the other side and Matthew Settle has a spooky experience with the spirit of a distraught woman.

videos.title: Jermaine Jackson, Karina Smirnoff, Diane Ladd, Haylie Duff
videos.overview: Jermaine Jackson encounters the spirit of an elderly woman haunting his family's estate; a desperate spirit contacts Diane Ladd and pleads for help; Dave Foley learns his apartment has a dark and brutal past; and an angry spirit attacks a young Karina Smirnoff.

videos.title: Christopher Knight, Carol Alt, Dick Van Patten, Marissa Jaret Winokur
videos.overview: Young Christopher Knight is visited by the spirit of a tormented girl; a spirit lures Carol Alt into buying her first home; Dick Van Patten is visited by a ghost who foreshadows his future; and Marissa Jaret Winokur stumbles upon a sad spirit in her friend's home.

videos.title: Deborah Gibson, Joey Pantoliano, Kimberly Locke, Willie Garson
videos.overview: Deborah Gibson receives a message from the ghost of her idol; a murdered matriarch terrorizes Joey Pantoliano and his girlfriend; Kimberly Locke faces off with an evil spirit; and Willie Garson discovers explores a ring belonging to his dead father.

videos.title: Laura Prepon, Vince Neil, Connie Stevens, Haylie Duff
videos.overview: A small room in Laura Prepon's new home leaves her feeling very uneasy; a young Vince Neil hears mysterious noises coming from his bedroom closet; Connie Stevens discovers that she and her children are not alone in their new L.A. mansion; and Haylie Duff has an encounter that leaves her with a dark premonition.

videos.title: Daryl Hannah, Maxim Chmerkovskiy, Shana Moakler and Marilyn Manson
videos.overview: A young Daryl Hannah meets a mysterious woman who changes her life forever. Maksim Chmerkovskiy recovers from a devastating injury with the help of a woman who's not what she seems. As a young model Shanna Moakler is provoked by a restless spirit. A teenage Marilyn Manson faces terrifying consequences after reading an ancient text.

videos.title: Rebecca DeMornay, Michael Rappaport, and Margaret Cho
videos.overview: Faced with the possibility of death, Rebecca De Mornay is greeted by angelic spirits. A young Michael Rapaport and friends stumble upon ghosts in their high school basement. Margaret Cho moves into a new house and discovers she's not the only inhabitant of the home.

videos.title: Vince Neil, Charisma Carpenter, Cynthia Rowley, Orlando Jones
videos.overview: Spiraling into a deep depression, Vince Neil has an encounter that brings him back to life . A young Charisma Carpenter must fight off an evil energy into her childhood home. Cynthia Rowley flees her vacation home after discovering the history of its previous owner; and a missing memento forces Orlando Jones to face a deceased family member.

videos.title: Don Most, Gina Lee Nolan, Fred Willard, Lolita Davidovich
videos.overview: Don Most takes on the apparition who haunts his girlfriend's home; Gena Lee Nolin is confronted by a murdered spirit when it appears during a violent exorcism; a protective force warns Fred Willard and his family about a forthcoming disaster; Lolita Davidovich is contacted by the spirit of a close friend and role model after her untimely death.

videos.title: Taylor Hicks, Janine Turner, Charles Dutton, Joshua Leonard
videos.overview: After an encounter with a mysterious woman, Taylor Hicks receives a life-changing message. Janine Turner discovers a remnant from the past. Charles S. Dutton disturbs the grave of a New Orleans man. Joshua Leonard is haunted by images of a horrific death.

videos.title: Shelley Long, Daniel Stern, Gail O'Grady, Matt Sorum
videos.overview: Shelley Long confronts civil war spirits. Daniel Stern and his wife vacation in a haunted town. Gail O'Grady receives a reassuring message from her deceased brother. Recording in a music studio, Matt Sorum discovers ghosts haunting its hallways.

videos.title: Sugar Ray Leonard, Aida Turturro, Larry Manetti, Johnathon Schaech
videos.overview: Battling with inner demons after retiring, Sugar Ray Leonard is awoken one evening by the appearance of a mysterious young girl. Aida Turturro's deceased father contacts her from the other side; Larry Manetti is questioned about the disappearance of a young woman who visits his hotel room hours prior to her death; Johnathon Schaech receives a message from the ghost of a famous trickster.

videos.title: Joey Lawrence, Gabrielle Carteris, John Ventimiglia, Paul Shaffer
videos.overview: The ghost of a murdered bride haunts Joey Lawrence and his family at the Pfister Hotel. Gabrielle Carteris is guided through a difficult time by her late grandfather's spirit. A young John Ventimiglia is mistaken as the child of a ghost who haunts him. Caught at a crossroads in life, Paul Shaffer is visited by the spirit of his most loyal friend and supporter in a college dorm room.

videos.title: Cheri Oteri, Corbin Bernsen, John Schneider, Sharon Angela
videos.overview: After the tragic loss of her father, Cheri Oteri visits a medium who channels his spirit from the other side. Corbin Bernsen is given a powerful message that steers him off his path of self-destruction. Living with memories that were not his own, John Schneider discovers a secret about his dead brother; detained in a Wiccan shop, Sharon Angela is saved by a spirit that changes the course of events to come.

videos.title: Regis Philbin, Harry Hamlin, Ana Gasteyer, Jaime King
videos.overview: Regis Philbin spends a terrifying night in a notorious haunted house trying to coax its ghosts into sight; Harry Hamlin's wedding proposal is foiled by a ghost with a broken heart; Ana Gasteyer comes face-to-face with tragic spirits in a theater; and model and movie star Jaime King is attacked by an evil entity in her family's country home.

videos.title: Bret Michaels, Natasha Henstridge, Penelope Ann Miller, Eva Amurri
videos.overview: Faced with a decision that would change his life, Bret Michaels is visited by a close relative who points him toward his destiny; followed by a mysterious entity Natasha Henstridge is terrified when it manifests itself in her new home; as a child Penelope Ann Miller is met by her grandmother shortly after her death; on a trip to her boyfriend's family home in Charlestown, Eva Amurri uncovers the gruesome murder of an innocent woman.

videos.title: Jerry Stiller, Mindy McCready, Nick Hogan, Lourdes Benedicto
videos.overview: Jerry Stiller receives a long awaited message from his father; a maternal figure appears to Mindy McCready at one of the darkest moments of her life; Nick Hogan breaks into the forbidden floor of an old hotel and discovers its violent past; and Lourdes Benedicto encounters a lingering spirit who refuses to leave her childhood home.

videos.title: Mindy Cohn, Valerie Harper, Matthew Gray Gubler, Nicole Eggert
videos.overview: Looking for the perfect sanctuary to finish her book, Mindy Cohn is confronted with anything but solitude at a famous Pasadena apartment building; while at a crossroads in her career, a young Valerie Harper comes face to face with a ghostly debutant who points her in the right direction; Matthew Gray Gubler experiences a haunting in an eccentric Hollywood apartment building with a tragic past; and Nicole Eggert's daughter makes friends with an otherworldly spirit.

videos.title: Best Of
videos.overview: A "Best Of" one hour special. Joan Rivers asks a voodoo priestess to help her with an angry ghost; Michael Imperioli meets a tormented spirit at a legendary New York hotel; Jeffrey Ross's high-flying lifestyle is brought down to earth by a strange haunting; and Elizabeth Rohm's blissful retreat from the grind of Law & Order is interrupted by an unhappy spirit.

videos.title: Keshia Knight Pulliam, Ming-Na, Chi McBride and Mia Tyler
videos.overview: Keisha Knight Pulliam encounters a lingering family spirit; while making renovations on her new house, Ming-Na discovers a previous owner is reluctant to leave; during one of the darkest moments of his life, Chi McBride is sent a message of hope from a powerful political figure who had an untimely death; Mia Tyler is visited by a guardian spirit when her relationship turns sour.

videos.title: Brett Butler, Cassandra Peterson, Phil Varone and Ana Gasteyer
videos.overview: A protective spirit saves Brett Butler from an abusive relationship; a murdered man threatens Cassandra Peterson's life in her own home; lonely spirits stalk Phil Varone in his Los Angeles mansion; and Ana Gasteyer inadvertently summons the former residents of a historic hotel to her suite.

videos.title: Beverly D'Angelo, Sally Struthers, and Melissa George
videos.overview: Beverly D'Angelo invokes Cass Elliot's spirit in her new home; Sally Struthers is visited by the apparition of a woman who fell tragically to her death in her home; and Melissa George is chastised by the incarnation of evil energy during the filming of The Amityville Horror.

videos.title: Loretta Lynn
videos.overview: Country music superstar Loretta Lynn, the “Queen of Country,” invites viewers into her legendary, and HAUNTED, Tennessee estate. In this exclusive and highly personal special, world-renowned medium Kim Russo travels to Loretta’s home to reveal the darkest and most surprising details of this true-life Celebrity Ghost Story. It’s a rare glimpse into the life of a legend as she re-connects with her lost loved ones and unlocks the past of her famous home.

videos.title: Alan Thicke, Fairuza Balk, Kevin Pollak and Laila Ali
videos.overview: Alan Thicke and his son encounter a murderous Russian ghost while visiting Moscow. On her first trip to Los Angeles alone, sixteen year old Fairuza Balk is attacked by an evil energy in her hotel room bed. Kevin Pollak comes face to face with the other side when his girlfriend is possessed by the dead crying out for help. Boxing champion Laila Ali wasn’t afraid of anything until she was terrorized by a spirit in her friend’s home.

videos.title: Dyan Cannon, Wendi McLendon-Covey, Quinton Aaron and Bridget Marquardt
videos.overview: A young Dyan Cannon is visited in the night by a guardian spirit. Wendi McLendon-Covey has a paranormal encounter after a walk through a cemetery. Quinton Aaron encounters a menacing spirit on a deserted college campus. And Bridget Marquardt connects with an evil spirit after playing with a Ouiji board.

videos.title: Joan Osborne, Ahmad Rashad, Mia Tyler and Renee Taylor
videos.overview: Joan Osborne is attacked by the ghost of a woman with a painful history; Ahmad Rashad is visited by a witch who guides him through some of the most challenging chapters of his life; Mia Tyler is attacked by the ghosts of abused hospital patients at a newly converted Los Angeles Hotel; haunted by her mother’s spirit, Renee Taylor is challenged to make things right.

videos.title: Chaka Khan, Kristin Bauer, Iqbal Theba
videos.overview: Chaka Khan is rescued by a guardian angel; Kristin Bauer encounters the spirit of her father; and Iqbal Theba is haunted by an evil spirit.

videos.title: Mickey Rooney, Brande Roderick, Eric Mabius, Kim Coles
videos.overview: Mickey Rooney receives a life-changing message from the other side. A demonic entity terrorizes Brande Roderick throughout her life. Eric Mabius discovers the tragic past of a grieving ghost. And a guardian angel saves Kim Coles from an abusive relationship.

videos.title: Beverley Mitchell, Mark Curry, Donovan Leitch and Phyllis Diller
videos.overview: Beverley Mitchell uncovers the evil past of an abandoned insane asylum; Mark Curry awakens an angry spirit in his new home; Donovan Leitch unearths an uninvited guest at his country house; and Phyllis Diller comes face to face with the ghost of her childhood muse.

videos.title: Susan Olsen, Rita Coolidge, Fairuza Balk and Enrico Colantoni
videos.overview: Susan Olsen is viciously attacked by a jealous spirit; Rita Coolidge defends herself against evil entities; Fairuza Balk confronts two ghosts who died tragically; and Enrico Colantoni receives closure 30 years after the death of his sister.

videos.title: Christopher Atkins, Maria Conchita Alonso and Scott Patterson
videos.overview: Scott Patterson encounters ghosts on death row; Maria Conchita Alonso is haunted by the tragic death of her best friend; and Christopher Atkins discovers a horrifying secret from a past life.

videos.title: Cindy Williams, Audrina Patridge, Giancarlo Espisito, Joan Van Ark
videos.overview: Cindy Williams is attacked by an evil, malicious spirit; Audrina Patridge is followed home by a malevolent ghost; Giancarlo Esposito encounters a family of apparitions who have yet to cross over to the other side; Joan Van Ark unwittingly invokes the spirit she was hired to portray and reunites two long lost lovers.

videos.title: Billy Dee Williams, Jenna Morasga, Dee Wallace and Katherine Narducci
videos.overview: Billy Dee Williams escapes from a home in Los Angeles after he has a terrifying encounter with the spirit of a woman who was tragically killed in the home. Trying to get in touch with her recently deceased mother, Jenna Morasca conjures up evil spirits who are out to do her harm. Dee Wallace has a complicated relationship with her alcoholic father and has an unexpected reunion and Katherine Narducci is frightened for her life after visiting a cemetery.

videos.title: Erik Estrada, Micah Sloat, Joan Osborne, Reginald VelJohnson
videos.overview: Erik Estrada is visited by an apparition who comes to his rescue just in the nick of time. Micah Sloat and his sister encounter horrifying paranormal activity in their own home. While on tour with her band, Joan Osborne discovers a bar inhabited by the restless spirits of children and Reginald VelJohnson moves into a new home unaware that the previous owner refuses to leave.

videos.title: Rowdy Roddy Piper, Skylar Grey, Frank Whaley
videos.overview: After Rowdy's best friend Adrian Adonis dies tragically, Rowdy learns that Adrian has his back even from the beyond. Skylar Grey, at a low point in her career, is viciously attacked by an evil spirit in her hotel room. Frank Whaley's young son has a visitor, and Frank and his wife are run out of town.

videos.title: Aaron Carter, Chris McDonald, Kaya Jones, David Proval
videos.overview: Aaron Carter's dying grandmother makes him promise her that he will perform a ritual after she dies to prove that spirits really do exist. Chris McDonald and his brother discover a secret door that unleashes the ghosts of people who once found safe haven in his home. Kaya Jones' dream apartment turns into a nightmare and David Proval is terrified for his life, when someone from the other side comes to his rescue.

videos.title: Tito Ortiz; Cary Elwes; Sally Kellerman; Drake Bell
videos.overview: One of the toughest men in the world, Tito Ortiz, encounters a spirits that terrifies him and his girlfriend. Cary Elwes has a brush with a bone chilling skeletal ghost in a Spanish castle. Sally Kellerman encounters a ghost she will never forget and Drake Bell becomes obsessed with a haunted house near a movie set.

videos.title: Tiffany, Tony Plana, Morgan Brittany
videos.overview: An angry teenage Tiffany reads the Satanic bible and unleashes evil from the other side. Tony Plana encounters a cannibalistic entity that leaves him fearing for his life and Morgan Brittany is haunted by the ghost of a young actress seeking the spotlight.

videos.title: Lorenzo Lamas, Charles Shaughnessy, Kristen Renton
videos.overview: Lorenzo Lamas comes face to face with the spirit of a famous actress who is trying to contact his mother. Charles Schaughnessy encounters an angry poltergiest. On the notoriously haunted Queen Mary, Kristen Renton is chased by an angry ghost.

videos.title: Tyler Blackburn, Lainie Kazan, Shari Headley
videos.overview: Tyler experiences series of unexplainable, terrifying encounters with some angry spirits; Lainie Kazan loses the love of her life, but gets to see him just one last time; Shari Headley moves her family into a new home, but is tormented by a ghost who refuses to depart.

videos.title: Jordan Ladd, Adrienne Barbeau, Kyle Massey, Brett Cullen
videos.overview: Jordan uncovers an unsolved crime scene with the help of the menacing spirit of the murder victim; Adrienne witnesses her deceased grandmother comforting her dying mother and later discovers they have been reunited in the afterlife; Kyle and his family are terrorized by a spirit who winds up saving their home; Brett and his family are shocked when they find out they are being haunted by ghosts from the Civil War.

videos.title: Jack Osbourne, Stephen Collins, Aasha Davis, David Lander
videos.overview: Jack and his family experience unexplained phenomena at their estate; Stephen is granted one more chance to say goodbye; Aasha finds out her friend is actually a spirit; David is visited by a former inhabitant of his apartment.

videos.title: Erin Moran, Pia Zadora, Michael Beach
videos.overview: Erin and her husband are terrorized by restless spirits after they stumble upon an old mineshaft on their new property; after moving into Pickfair, the former estate of Douglas Fairbanks and Mary Pickford, Pia and her children are tormented by the ghost of a starlet; when Michael s aunt passes, he is terrified by her lifeless body in the open casket at her funeral, but she later assures him there is nothing to be scared about.

videos.title: Diane Neal, Debbie Allen, Kevin Sorbo, Debbie Matenopoulos
videos.overview: After Diane and her middle school friends trample upon the grave of an infamous cannibal and poke fun at his abominable deeds, they quickly regret their actions; a young Debbie Allen is at the low point of her life when she is visited by the spirit of her deceased grandmother; Kevin and his girlfriend take an early morning drive around a local lake and encounter a ghastly dead bride searching for revenge; Debbie Matenopoulos moves into a fabulous Hollywood estate and soon discovers that the home is cursed.

videos.title: Titus Welliver, Johnny Gill, Marcus Schenkenberg
videos.overview: Titus' family buys a summer home in Maine and discovers that the malevolent spirits living in their barn were murdered in a mass killing right on their property; while recording some music, Johnny is haunted by a ghost who doesn't always appreciate his talents; while staying at a posh Los Angeles hotel, Marcus is visited by the spirit of a woman who was unfairly evicted from the hotel. He quickly learns a lesson: do not to make fun of ghosts.

videos.title: Biz Markie, Erik Palladino, Rita Rudner
videos.overview: Biz's career is at a crossroads when he is confronted by a ghost who winds up having some sound advice; Erik is invited to an acting retreat and is assaulted by a nightmarish entity with a tragic past; Rita's heart is broken at young age, but she receives solace when she meets a visitor from the other side.

videos.title: Dick Cavett, Monica Keena,Ace Young, Paul Iacono
videos.overview: When Dick stumbles upon a mysterious young woman in an old southern mansion, his distressed host exclaims to her father, "Daddy, she's back." Monica is threatened by the previous inhabitants of her home who turn her house into a living hell; Ace Young is haunted by a menacing woman whose life came to a tragic end; Paul encounters an entity that terrifies and confuses him, but solidifies his belief in the afterlife.

videos.title: Lewis Black, Meshach Taylor, Samantha Harris
videos.overview: Lewis takes a summer job in the Michigan woods and is visited by unseen entities who torment him at night; Meshach is visited by the ghost of an evil child predator who tries to lure him into the swamp near his home; Samantha and her friends visit the site of a mass murder during an overnight camping trip.

videos.title: Charo, William Mapother, Justin Guarini, Hope Dworaczyk
videos.overview: Charo is attacked by a deranged woman who killed herself 30 years prior in the same apartment; while on vacation in Hawaii with his family, a young William encounters the ghost of a woman from a leper colony; Justin is tormented by a family of unsettled spirits; Hope and her siblings are hounded by the ghost of a wheelchair-bound boy that died in the house.

videos.title: Bill Bellamy, Dawn Wells, Jack Blades, Mary Lambert
videos.overview: Bill moves into a house that is inhabited by the ghost of a little girl who had a tragic accident there; Dawn invites some young actors to her home and after some seemingly innocent dabbling into the occult, they come to deeply regret their actions; Jack comes face to face with the spirits of Native American warriors out for revenge; Mary moves into Hollywood mansion and is haunted by the previous owner who had delusions of grandeur.

videos.title: D.B. Sweeney, Adrien Zmed, Eddie Money, DJ Nicole Leone
videos.overview: While seeking inspiration for their screenplay, D.B. and his friend stumble upon a motel and are accosted by a murderous entity; while performing the show "Grease" at the National Theater, Adrian is attacked by a jealous leading man from the 1800s; Eddie visits the home of a little girl ghost who pays him an unexpected visit; originally from New Zealand, Nicole gets a traditional aboriginal tattoo that opens her senses to the paranormal.

videos.title: Linda Blair, Carlos Mencia, Victoria Rowell, Dot Jones
videos.overview: Linda and her sister discover an old rundown house in the woods with a murderous history; Carlos Mencia is nearly shot and killed when a spirit from his past comes to his rescue; Victoria Rowell discovers the home she was raised in was built on a burial ground; Dot Jones is terrified by a ghost who she realizes is not out to hurt her, but to watch over her.

videos.title: Tracy Scoggins, Fairuza Balk, Della Reese, Patrick Muldoon
videos.overview: After losing her new boyfriend, Tracy seeks solitude in the dark arts and strikes a deal with the devil; Fairuza is attacked and nearly killed in her art studio by a ferocious entity; Della is moments away from death when she is saved by her guardian angel; a spirit follows Patrick Muldoon out of cemetery and forces him into a battle for his life.

videos.title: 20 Most Evil Entities
Jackee Harry, Louie Anderson, Angie Stone, Richard Burgi
videos.overview: A malicious child predator enters Jackee s home and she is rescued by her guardian angel; after a performance, Louie Anderson is visited by the ghost of his mother who had suddenly passed; Angie Stone loses the love of her life who comes back to help her once again find true love; Richard is terrorized by the ghost of a revolutionary freedom fighter.

videos.title: Patricia Velasquez, Susie Essman, Elya Baskin
videos.overview: Patricia is terrorized by a ghost who escapes from the pages of an antique book; Susie feels she has made biggest mistake of her life but finds forgiveness and unconditional love from the spirit of her grandmother; in communist Russia, Elya encounters the wrath of an entity seeking revenge.

videos.title: Lisa Lisa, Bernie Kopell, Enrico Colantoni, Heather McDonald
videos.overview: After moving into an old country house, Enrico has a series of horrifying encounters that make him realize he s not the only one residing in the home. When the girls that Lisa babysits every day go missing, Lisa has a terrifying vision that reveals a tragic ending. Bernie is accosted by the ghost of a woman who was bludgeoned to death on her wedding day. Heather is physically attacked by an entity that depletes all her energy.

videos.title: Beverly Johnson, Charlene Tilton, Jimmy Wayne
videos.overview: After the loss of her true love, Beverly is tormented by evil spirits bent on her destruction. Charlene purchases a home haunted by a murdered woman who frightens her, while trying to protect Charlene from her manager. While singer Jimmy Wayne struggles to compose his masterpiece, he encounters the spirit of a country music legend who lends a helping hand.

videos.title: Mariel Hemmingway; Kevin Brown, Curtis Armstrong
videos.overview: A deadly presence inhabits Mariel's home, threatening her very existence; Kevin nearly perishes in a deadly fire when his life is saved by someone from the other side; Curtis Armstrong's household is frequented upon by a ghost that visits his daughter at night.

videos.title: George Wendt, Wayne Newton and Ace Frehley
videos.overview: George and his family spend a tortuous night in a cottage haunted by Native Americans and bootleggers; Wayne Newton is paid a surprise visit by the ghost of his dear friend Elvis Presley while performing in Las Vegas; there are vengeful entities in Ace Frehley's estate and all the women in the home are in peril.

videos.title: Marisa Ramirez, Jimmie Walker, Lisa Vidal and Kate Vernon
videos.overview: Bloody visions of a violent tragedy haunt Marisa's childhood; Jimmie runs out of gas on an icy, North Dakota road and encounters a mysterious apparition; a close friend of Lisa's dies violently and returns from the other side; Kate has a terrifying paranormal experience that she will never forget.

videos.title: Shar Jackson, Blair Brown, Esai Morales and John Hensley
videos.overview: Shar discovers the body of her friend after he inexplicably commits suicide and soon discovers the shocking truth behind the tragedy; Blair and her family are menaced by the violent spirit of an insane man; Esai encounters a terrifying entity hovering outside his apartment; John's skepticism of the paranormal is reversed forever after he has his own phenomenal encounter.

videos.title: Coco, Craig Kilborn, Diana DeGarmo and Tommy Davidson
videos.overview: A lost male spirit obsessed with Coco attacks her and threatens her life; Craig Kilborn encounters a murderous spirit who kills harmless animals; Diana's brother plays with a spirit board and invites a dark spirit into their home; Tommy is visited by recently deceased love ones.

videos.title: Tom Green, Anthony Michael Hall, Brenda Epperson and Jacklyn Zeman
videos.overview: Tom gets more than what he bargained for when he stays overnight in a haunted museum; while recording a record, Anthony is visited by a spirit who has recently crossed over; a menacing, violent spirit haunts Brenda's new home; after sharing a paranormal experience, Jacklyn and her aunt make a pact about the afterlife--that comes true.

videos.title: Richard Grieco, Anthony Michael Hall, Ana Ortiz, Barry Bostwick
videos.overview: Richard dabbles in the dark arts and pays a horrifying price; Ana is preyed upon in a home with a murderous past; Barry encounters the ghost of a lost child who drowned in a pond near his home.

videos.title: Nadine Velazquez, Burt Ward, Adrianna Costa, Bruce Davison
videos.overview: Nadine is tormented by an evil entity that was mauled to death in her home; Burt stays overnight in a remote inn and encounters the ghosts of the criminally insane; a lost ring leads Adrianna to her true love and her grandfather's watchful spirit; Bruce is shocked when he crosses paths with the ghosts of two young boys.

videos.title: Jillian Barberie, Dan Cortese and Bruce Boxleitner
